mapper.select: select gc.common_id as commonId, gc.common_sell_time as commonSellTime from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb ON gc.common_id = gb.common_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON gc.shop_id = sb.supplier_shop_id where gc.common_state = 4 AND gc.common_verify = 1 AND gc.common_is_screen = 1 AND sb.shop_status = 3 AND gc.common_price != 0
